item.description: Miami, FL - January 21, 2026 - Istituto Marangoni Miami hosted an in-depth conversation with Craig Robins, Founder and CEO of Dacra and the visionary behind the Miami Design District. item.description: Miami, FL - January 23, 2026 - Miami’s national culinary spotlight is shining brightest on two standout names redefining the city’s dining scene.
